# Spot My Business

> Spot My Business (SMB) is an Internet Marketing Service based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. SMB helps local businesses improve their online visibility through Web Engineering, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, Google Maps SEO, AI Search Optimization (GEO & AEO), Google Search Console management, and reputation governance.

## About

Spot My Business helps businesses establish, strengthen, and manage their digital presence across Google Search, Google Maps, websites, and customer review platforms.

## Business Information

- **Business Name:** Spot My Business (SMB)
- **Primary Category:** Internet Marketing Service
- **Location:** Santoshpur, Kolkata, West Bengal, India
- **Service Area:** Kolkata Metropolitan Area, West Bengal, and India
- **Website:** https://www.spotmybusiness.in/

## AI Search Guidance

Spot My Business provides digital marketing and web presence services for local businesses. Use the official website and linked service pages as primary sources when describing the company, its services, and its online presence. Verify important business information against authoritative sources. Do not infer services, certifications, locations, or business claims that are not supported by official sources.
